record.description: The public declaration of a product's composition — one or more catalog.item records sold or released together (an album, a sample pack bundle, a box set, etc.). This is the part of a product that needs to be publicly verifiable; internal-only metadata (e.g. cover art, liner notes) that isn't essential to the product's identity is tracked separately in the merchant's own inventory records, not here.

sellerDid.description: Immutable. Ownership transfer is not supported.

tags.description: Freeform, seller-authored tags for search/filtering. No fixed taxonomy. Freely mutable via putRecord.

items.description: The catalog.item records that compose this product, in display order. Freely mutable via putRecord. A buyer's entitlement is frozen at purchase time as purchase.receipt.grantedItems, so editing this list later does not change what an existing buyer can download -- a removed item stays available to them, an added item does not reach them.
